_README: SAFE TEMPLATE for himalaya/accounts.json - the display-metadata registry mailops reads (ids, addresses, display names, which account is default). NO credentials live in this file on any platform. The real 39-entry file is operational data and is deliberately NOT shipped in this release archive; it must stay in lock-step with himalaya/config.toml and data/settings.json['active_accounts'] (see docs/AWS_RELEASE_TRANSFER.md section 6). Replace this entry with the real registry before use. Unknown keys such as this one are ignored by mailops/config.py::load_accounts.
